owner_approval: All five review decisions approved on 2026-07-19; C2.1 is authorized only as a separate internal proof target.
metadata_envelope: Option A in config/c2-metadata-envelope-proposal.json approved on 2026-07-19; C2.1 emits and decodes that exact local 24-byte envelope.
claim_limit: Approved C2.0 design contract only. It changes no product byte, authorizes no capacity, and makes no execution or performance claim until the separate C2.1 proof target passes.

design_laws.substitution: The C2 product decoder replaces the L65M materializer; the two never coexist in one product candidate.
design_laws.physical_address_domain: All 28-bit physical addresses are uint32 values or explicit DMA-list bytes and never pass through the target's 16-bit uintptr_t.
design_laws.immutability: Executable Attic bytes are never patched after staging. Session objects, literal resolutions and export cells live in a separate mutable plane.
design_laws.attic_cache: Every Attic tenant is identity-checked, generation-bound, reconstructible, and never the sole copy of user data.
design_laws.fail_fast: Every new device behavior receives a receipt-less pre-smoke before an authoritative chain.

logical_callable.encoding: existing 12-bit directory index in raw object range 0xc000..0xdffe
logical_callable.meaning: session-local callable handle only; never a physical address
logical_callable.stale_rule: BCODE values are valid only in the session generation that created their directory. A restage starts a new session and clears heap, directory and all resolution tables before publishing any callable.

source_address.physical_computation: uint32_t physical = region_base_u32 + offset_u24; checked for 28-bit overflow before DMA-list encoding
forbidden: store a physical address in obj
publish an address without artifact identity and generation

shelf_format.name: L65S-v4-direct
shelf_format.inherits: The host-validated 32-byte header, 32-byte records, u24 region offsets and split code/metadata layout from the 2026-07-18 L65S-v4 model.
shelf_format.strictness: The C2 decoder accepts only L65S-v4-direct and known flags. It rejects v3, widening-only v4 and unknown versions. The v1.1 product continues to accept only v3.

identity.host: complete shelf SHA-256, region SHA-256 and product-set SHA-256
identity.device: product build identity, complete-catalog CRC32 and per-region CRC32
identity.diagnostic_map: host map SHA is bound to the exact shelf SHA and product-set SHA

shelf_format.media_rule: Code and metadata are staged together before the single product-to-work-disk swap. No D81-only metadata side file is permitted.

direct_container.name: C2I-v1
direct_container.code_region: Immutable normalized code objects. Literal-table-shaped bytes are zero in the stored image and are ignored by PUSHLIT.
direct_container.metadata_region: Entry records, literal descriptors, export descriptors and immutable strings. It is reset-persistent but never contains a session obj.

entry_record.code_length_rule: legal lengths are 1..65535; zero is a format error
entry_record.anonymous_sentinel: export_name_offset=0xffff; every legal offset is strictly below 0xffff

literal_descriptor.fixnum_rule: fixnum-i16 is a signed transport field, but legal values are restricted to the dialect Fixnum range -16384..16383; every other value is a format error
literal_descriptor.cross_container_rule: Container-local references use ordinals. Cross-container references use exported names only. Late-bound exports are always name descriptors and are never rewritten to entry ordinals.

mutable_session_plane.session_generation: nonzero u16; incremented on each stage/restage; wrap is fail-closed and requires a cold boot
mutable_session_plane.directory: BCODE index to image slot, entry ordinal, code length and literal-resolution base
mutable_session_plane.resolution_table: One obj per literal descriptor, rebuilt from immutable descriptors for the current session generation
mutable_session_plane.export_cells: Mutable function cells keyed by interned export symbol; late-bound replacement changes only the cell
mutable_session_plane.export_rollback: Before publication, a bounded journal records each target symbol, whether its function cell was bound, and its prior value. Failure restores changed cells in reverse order before any watermark rollback; success discards the journal.
publication_order: allocate unpublished directory and resolution ranges
journal prior bound state and value of every target export cell
mutable_session_plane.rollback: Any failure first restores overwritten function cells from the export journal, then restores directory, resolution and export watermarks. No partially published callable survives.

code_window.mechanism: A single hot code window is refilled by Enhanced DMA from the identity-bound source address for the current entry and PC.
code_window.refill_key: product identity, shelf identity, session generation, image slot, entry ordinal, code offset
checks: entry and PC stay inside the immutable code region
requested bytes do not cross the entry length
generation and shelf identity still match before every refill
code_window.geometry: C2.1 measures and pins window size, refill quantum and nested-call behavior; C2.0 does not spend capacity by assumption.

reset_and_restage.platform_reset: Returns to platform firmware and is not a Lisp session restart.
reset_and_restage.cold_boot: Stager verifies and reconstructs the complete shelf cache, then creates a new mutable session plane.
reset_and_restage.product_restart_c2_3: Keeps verified immutable Attic tenants, increments session generation, clears mutable state, rebuilds resolutions and exports, and starts a fresh REPL.
reset_and_restage.hot_restage: Forbidden. A shelf identity change requires a full new session before any new callable is published.
reset_and_restage.stale_reference_result: No stale value remains reachable; any internal generation mismatch is a fail-closed runtime-catalog error.

staged_swap.artifact: host model and four-engine anonymous-helper proof closure
separate internal proof target using only L65S-v4-direct/C2I-v1
staged_swap.product_decoder: not linked into the Workbench product

staged_swap.artifact: atomic Workbench product cut; all shipped containers converted
staged_swap.product_decoder: C2 direct decoder replaces and funds itself from the retired L65M materializer
staged_swap.promotion: new product identity and full fresh R4/R5/R6/G5/G6

rollback_rule: Rollback selects the complete previous v1.1 artifact set. No product candidate contains a dual decoder or mixed v3/v4 shelf.
required_negative_fixtures: v3 shelf presented to C2 decoder
v4 shelf presented to v1.1 decoder
region offset at or beyond the u24 envelope
legal name offset attempting to use 0xffff
late-bound edge encoded as an ordinal
hot restage attempted in a live session
failure after resolution allocation but before export publication

c2_0_exit.contract: owner-approved exact address, identity, reset and staged-swap contract
c2_0_exit.prototype: one SHA-bound anonymous helper executes direct, funcall, apply and closure/tail-call coverage in all four engines
c2_0_exit.claim: internal proof only; no product promotion
